decimal-round function 

@function decimal-round($number, $digits: 0, $mode: round) {

Rounds a number to N decimal digits using the given rounding mode. `round`/`floor` wrap in calc() so the result stays a math expression Sass can still compose; `ceil` returns a plain number (Sass has no native CSS ceil() at this pinned Sass version). Non-number inputs warn and pass through unchanged instead of failing the whole compile — a typo in one call site shouldn't kill the build.

Parameters

  • $number Number — Value to round.
  • $digits Number default: 0 — Decimal places to keep (must be unitless).
  • $mode String default: round — `round`, `ceil`, or `floor`.

Returns

Number The rounded value (or the input when invalid).

to-vw function 

@function to-vw($value, $viewport) {

Converts a px length to a vw percentage of a reference viewport.

Parameters

  • $value Number — Length in px.
  • $viewport Number — Reference viewport width in px.

Returns

String A `vw`-suffixed value rounded to 3 decimals.

Converts a px length to a vmin percentage of a reference height.

Parameters

Returns

String A `vmin`-suffixed value rounded to 3 decimals.

to-rem function 

@function to-rem($value) {

Converts a px (or unitless px-meaning) number to rem at the 16px root. The px unit is stripped first so `to-rem(16px)` and `to-rem(16)` both yield 1rem — Fibonacci $space-* tokens are declared unitless.

Parameters

  • $value Number — px length or unitless px count.

Returns

String A `rem`-suffixed value rounded to 3 decimals.

Parameters

Returns

Number Percentage rounded to 3 decimals.

ignore-br mixin 

@mixin ignore-br() {

Neutralizes <br> inside the scope — `content: ' '` collapses the line break (and the generated content) so copy with <br> can be flattened on narrow layouts without editing the markup.

proportional-line mixin 

@mixin proportional-line($font-size, $line-height) {

Sets a unitless-proportional line-height in rem — lh/fs rounded to 2 decimals so the rhythm stays proportional when font-size is tweaked.

Parameters

  • $line-height Number — Desired line height.

grid-steps mixin 

@mixin grid-steps {

Emits one `min-width: (step−1)px` media query per `$grid-steps` entry. Steps ≤ 272 are skipped — the watch viewport is the base (un-queried) layout. Keeping a single iteration point guarantees %MAXAREA gutters and the debug overlay can never drift apart.

@content Receives `($step, $gap, $cols)` per breakpoint.

focus-ring mixin 

@mixin focus-ring {

Emits the focus-ring declarations (outline + offset) — nest under `&:focus-visible`. Inked by `--focus-ring` so the affordance matches the theme accent in both light and dark.

focus-ring-scope mixin 

@mixin focus-ring-scope {

Emits `:focus-visible` rules for every tabbable element type in the current scope — component sheets pull this in because document-level focus rules never pierce shadow DOM. `[tabindex='-1']` is excluded: those are programmatically-focused containers, not controls.

core/sass/base/_placeholders.scss

RESETBTN placeholder 

%RESETBTN {

Bare-button reset — removes UA chrome (background, border, outline, padding) plus the iOS tap highlight; extended by every icon-only or custom-styled control.

MAXAREA placeholder 

%MAXAREA {

The site's main layout constraint — full-width content column whose horizontal padding IS the grid gutter per breakpoint. Iterates $grid-steps via the `grid-steps` mixin so the content gutters and the show-grid debug overlay always read the same table.

SKEL_DARK_SURFACE placeholder 

%SKEL_DARK_SURFACE {

Dark-surface skeleton palette — redefines --skel-bg-*/--skel-ink as color-mix() lifts of --bg-dark toward white. The vars are redeclared (not derived from --skel-surface) because color-mix() inside a custom property resolves at the declaration site — descendants would otherwise inherit the :root light-surface values.
